questions_and_answers.question_text: What does zài guò + a time amount mean?
What are the two meanings of qǐmǎ?
What is the literal meaning of qiángguó?
Write the Chinese for "At the beginning of next year I'm going to Shànghǎi."
Write the Chinese for "He has been studying Chinese for at least five years."

answers.answer_text: Tā xué Zhōngwén qǐmǎ yǒu wǔnián le.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "He doesn't even understand the most basic manners!"

answers.answer_text: Lián qǐmǎde lǐmào dōu bù dǒng!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Give the Chinese for "the most basic conditions" and "the minimum level."
Write the Chinese for "We'll see about it at the beginning of next month!"
Write the Chinese for "I'll get used to life here in another few years."

answers.answer_text: Zài guò jǐnián wǒ jiù xíguàn zhèrde shēnghuó le.

articles.text:
4. A: Zài guò shínián, dào jiǔshí    In another ten years, in the early
      niándài chū, zhèige guójiā     nineties, this country will probably
      dàgài huì biànchéng yíge       become an economic power.
      jīngjì qiángguó.
   B: Bù xíng, qǐmǎ děi zài guò     No, it will be at least another twenty
      èrshinián.                     years.

Notes on No. 4

zài guò shínián: "in another ten years," "after another ten years have passed." More examples of (ZÀI) GUÒ + (Amount of Time):

Zài guò jǐnián wǒ jiù xíguàn     I'll get used to life here in another
zhèrde shēnghuó le.              few years.
Guò jǐtiān tā jiù yào qù         In a few days, he will be going to
Yìdàlì zuò lǐngshì le.           Italy to be consul.

-chū: "at the BEGINNING of" a time period

Míngniánchū wǒ qù Shànghǎi.      At the beginning of next year I'm going
                                 to Shànghǎi.
Yuèchū zài shuō ba!              We'll see about it at the beginning of
                                 (next) month!
Wénhuà Dà Gémìng chū wǒmen shéi  At the beginning of the Cultural
dōu hái bù zhīdào shi zěnme      Revolution, none of us knew what it was
huí shì.                         all about yet.

qiángguó: "strong-country," i.e., "a (world) POWER"

qǐmǎ: (1) "AT LEAST"

Tā xué Zhōngwén qǐmǎ yǒu wǔnián  He has been studying Chinese for at
le, dànshi hái shuōde bù hǎo.    least five years, but he still doesn't
                                 speak well.
Zhèige rén zhēn néng pǎo,        This guy can really run. Every day he
měitiān qǐmǎ pǎo shíèr yīnglǐ.   runs at least twelve miles.

(2) "MINIMUM, lowest (required to be acceptable), most basic, rudimentary"

Zhèige rén! Lián qǐmǎde lǐmào    This guy! He doesn't even understand
dōu bù dǒng!                     the most basic manners!

Similar expressions include qǐmǎde tiáojiàn, "the most basic conditions"; qǐmǎde zhīshi, "the most rudimentary knowledge"; and qǐmǎde shuǐpíng, "the minimum level."
